comments: Input facts: ego and agent1 are cars; ego initiates lateral incursion and agent1 responds; both initially travel in different lanes of the same trafficway. Chosen assumptions: a compact urban two-lane corridor with the cars initially abreast. After 0.6 s ego squeezes right toward agent1; agent1 reacts after ego enters its lane within 10 m, with a 0.15 s delay before sustained braking. Speeds are m/s, distances are m, and times are s. Collision is not a required outcome.
